name: University of South Wales
description: One of the largest universities in Wales, University of South Wales (USW) has over 30,000 students, including 3,500 international students from over 120 countries. Due to its size there are a wide range of courses on offer and a very vibrant student life-style. USW has over 100 partnerships with professional bodies and businesses and their focus is on equipping students with the skills and crucial experience needed to secure employment - 95% of USW graduates are in employment or further study within six months of graduating.
